comparison: All overlapping selected securities with archived primary target-date bars; retain every disagreement. This diagnostic does not activate an alternative source or override the failed Tencent comparison.

candidate_mapping.volume_lots: Source shares divided by 100, rounded half-up to whole lots.
candidate_mapping.turnover: Source turn percentage rounded half-up to two decimals.
candidate_mapping.pct: Source pctChg percentage rounded half-up to two decimals.
candidate_mapping.change: close minus the source preclose, preserving decimal arithmetic.
candidate_mapping.amplitude: (high-low)/source preclose*100, rounded half-up to two decimals.

mapping_status: A candidate mapping to verify across the full overlap, not a certified source equivalence.
